Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner assumed the 1967 Winnipeg track was a 440-yard oval and concluded the race used a short-start 24-lap configuration without verifying this. This unsupported historical assumption led to a premature “TASK_COMPLETE” with “24 laps,” contradicting the standard and correct count of 25 laps for a 10,000 m race on a 400 m track and lacking any sourced confirmation that the Pan American Games used a different lap count.
